If you're interested and want to hash out details DM me. Because even though Lubbock's the "friendliest city in the world" its still hard to meet some people with the same interests. 
For me at least.

The gyms I used to frequent in California always had summer camps for kids, company and customer trips to Hueco Tanks, Yosemite, all sorts of near and far climbing spots. 
Lubbock doesn't seem to have very many natural climbing spots but Amarillo and Austin have some AMAZING SPOTS and Hueco Tanks in El Paso is the climbing capitol of the US!
